title: The tariff bill on a $30,000 car
sub: Toyota pays 15% once on the sticker, Detroit pays 25% on its parts at six border crossings - $1,740 more for building it at home
src_full: DERIVED from $30,000 x 15% (USTR, the US-Japan finished-auto rate) and the hand-off's modelled stacked 25% parts duties (HTS 8708, CAR crossings)
